source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Voth Temple Ordinator and Tzintzun emerald-and-gold liturgical tapestry: deep sanctum emerald-green silk ground (#14523a, #0c2e20) outlined in soot-black (#161414) and richly woven in raised metallic gold thread (#d8a838) with bold 16-rayed Mexica-Indoril solar wheels alternating with diamond third-eye cartouches and notched Mayan xicalcoliuhqui step-fret rails (three solar cartouches across and two registers down), crisp woven thread relief, seam-safe. Full colour.
